instruction: I want to copy the movie titles in 'Garbage Movie Titles' column to the 'Clean Movie Titles' column. But please remove the adundant whitespaces and canonicalize the letter cases by capitalizing the first letter of each words and leave other letters as lower case. Finish the work and don't touch irrelevant regions, even if they are blank.

candidates.name: Text Cleaning Case Transforms and Normalization
candidates.description: Transform selected Calc text to uppercase, lowercase, or capitalize-each-word forms and keep text-cleanup workflows aligned with the requested normalization target.

candidates.name: Cleanup Highlights, Markers, and Sentence Spacing
candidates.description: Remove stale highlighting or inline markers and use scope-aware replace workflows to clean spacing or split sentence blocks without collapsing unrelated text.

candidates.name: Prepare Structured Text for Sorting and Deduplication
candidates.description: Convert record-like text into a sortable table and reach the sort surface so duplicate-heavy records can be grouped or cleaned instead of being forced through text-to-table alone.

candidates.name: Fill Copy Paste and Split Calc Data
candidates.description: Copy, paste, fill down, duplicate rows, or split text into columns while protecting existing values and keeping the destination range aligned with the task.

candidates.name: Apply Case Transforms and Rule-Based Text Formatting
candidates.description: Convert selected text between uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, or capitalize-each-word variants and verify the requested text form is visible on the page.

candidates.name: Regex-Based Text Classification and Batch Formatting
candidates.description: Use regular expressions inside Find and Replace to classify repeated text patterns, then apply formatting changes in controlled passes rather than one literal replacement.

candidates.name: Edit Calc Cell Values Comments and Find Replace
candidates.description: Type or replace cell content, add labels, manage comments, and use find/replace flows when the task is about literal cell edits.

candidates.name: Convert Or Extract Audio To MP3
candidates.description: Use VLC's Convert/Save flow to extract MP3 with the exact requested destination path and filename. Avoid drifting into Preferences unless a persistent saved default is explicitly required.

candidates.name: Sort and Filter Calc Tables
candidates.description: Apply sorts, auto-filters, and range filters to Calc tables and verify the visible filtered rows or ordering on the sheet.

candidates.name: Copy Matching Files In Terminal
candidates.description: Flat-copy matching files into a destination directory from Terminal and verify the copied file set without accidentally preserving the whole source tree.
